name: Celebs Go Dating
description: Single celebrities join an exclusive dating agency in a bid to find true love. Matchmakers pair them with non-celebrity partners and the cameras capture every romantic and cringe-filled moment.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At a singles mixer at the Celebrity Dating Agency, star clients mingle with everyday singletons and are challenged to ask them on dates. Joey Essex invites student Flo along to a date at Sugar Hut.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: It's the ladies' turn for a Singles Mixer. Paisley is on a high after her date with Thales, but she's read the signs wrong in the past.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Charlotte has a great first date with fish factory worker Brad, but is he all he seems? And Joey Essex is top of the class as the matchmakers' star pupil.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The celeb singletons are not making life easy for matchmakers Nadia and Eden. Stephanie has blasted their bad taste in men after they set her up with model Jack.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After joining the Celebrity Dating Agency, the celebs have just one week left to find love. Joey and Charlotte are sent out on a double date with Becky and Brad.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The celebs are thrown in the deep end as they go speed dating. They get five minutes per person and meet old and new faces. Can they spot true love in minutes? Steph finally has a good date with Piet.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As the speed dating continues, can Tyger up his game and bring his best chat to win over the gorgeous Frankie? Jack and Shirin head out on another date. Charlotte decides to give Brad a second chance.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Armed with new flirting techniques, Paisley hopes Davide is the one to break her run of dating bad luck. Nadia and Eden put everything on the line and send Steph and Joey on a date with each other.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The agency is putting three couples through a compatibility test to see if they really do have a shot. Charlotte and Brad go on a fishing trip, while Paisley is determined to get a kiss from Davide.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: The celebs head to a final dinner party but who will be taking a date? Will Tyger bring Frankie along, and will Shirin accept Jack's invite? Joey must choose between fellow celeb Steph and date Becky.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Celebrity Dating Agency opens its doors to another bunch of single celebrities who are all looking for love. But the stars aren't dating each other - they're dating real people in the real world. At the singles mixer, TV presenter Ferne McCann, Diversity's Perri Kiely, actress Jorgie Porter and TV rogue Stephen Bear mingle with everyday singletons. And what happens when Joey Essex returns?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ferne McCann has a date at a swanky restaurant, Jorgie Porter dates a fire fighter, and novice Perri Kiely embarks on his first ever date. The agents send Joey Essex on a blind date... with a cougar!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ferne McCann dates an investment banker with a property portfolio. Perri Kiely takes a blind date ice skating. Stephen Bear has no idea who the agents have set him up with, but he's in for a surprise

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Joey Essex takes country girl Sammi to a vegan eatery. Armed with lots of flirting tips, Jorgie Porter has a blind date with ex-rugby player James. Stephen Bear dates no-nonsense Liverpudlian Dakota

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Joey Essex spices things up on his 'edgiest' date so far. After two terrible dates, Ferne McCann is in tears. Perri Kiely wines and dines his third date. Stephen Bear comes to the agency for showdown

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: US reality TV star Jonathan Cheban and Pussycat Doll Melody Thornton sign on to the agency's books. How will the UK scene compare with dating Stateside? The celebrity girls attend their second mixer.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Jonathan Cheban proves to be a very fussy customer as the celebrity boys attend their second mixer. Will getting Joey Essex as his wing man give a nervous Perri Kiely some dating confidence?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Melody Thornton falls for her first date but is soon sent on a blind date with fella number two. Jonathan Cheban pulls out all the stops for his lunch date with Chanelle, arriving in a Bentley.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ferne McCann and Melody Thornton go on a double date to a top restaurant with their respective fellas. Jorgie Porter gives it everything she's got on date number two with James. Can she win his heart?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Ferne McCann has a dinner date disaster. Jonathan Cheban is sent on a double date with Stephen Bear to keep a lid on his outrageous, unpredictable behaviour. Jorgie Porter dates handsome model Will.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Gorgeous model Will sweeps Ferne McCann off her feet at a speed-dating event, but where does this leave her fella Lee? Jonathan Cheban's reunited with Chanelle, but Joey Essex is up to his old tricks.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Will Jorgie Porter and Melody Thornton be distracted by the buff blokes invited to the speed-dating event? Armed with flirting tips, Perri ups his game, but he brings a new deal breaker to the table.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: It's crunch time at the agency for Stephen Bear. Jonathan Cheban takes socialite Steph to a swanky restaurant to talk fashion, food and fads. Ferne McCann has a date with prison officer Luke.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jorgie Porter invites James to a showbiz event, but will he be out of his depth? Melody Thornton realises that she's already turned her blind date Benno down when he asked her out at a mixer.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Joey Essex has a blind date with Swedish singleton Mikaela. Perri Kiely goes on a date with a difference, wooing his girl while bathing with her in a hot tub! Jonathan Cheban meets Welsh beauty Ffion.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The celebrity boys go to another mixer, where Jonathan Cheban spots his ex, Chanelle. Will she woo him back with her charms? And will any potential dates working the room pass the Joey Essex test?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The female celebs go to another mixer but before Jorgie Porter can attend, she meets up with current flame James. Melody Thornton is determined to bag herself a Brit and throws herself into the event.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Jonathan Cheban jets off to Paris with his latest date, while Joey Essex is yet to find true love. Can Ferne McCann turn things around and bag the man of her dreams after a string of dating disasters?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Jorgie Porter is bidding to find Mr Right. Former dating novice Perri Kiely has gone from boy to man in just a month. Newly confident and ready to flirt, will he end up with a girlfriend on his arm?

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The agents host a romantic dinner party for the celebs to bring along the date of their dreams, but have they found someone who fits the bill to join them? And has Joey Essex located his perfect girl?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At the singles mixer, James 'Arg' Argent and Bobby Norris from TOWIE, Made in Chelsea's Georgia 'Toff' Toffolo, Charlotte Dawson from Ex on the Beach, and Calum Best mingle with non-famous singletons

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The stars have their first dates with members of the public. Arg goes for a curry with Yasemin, Toff is wined and dined by PhD student Laurent, and Calum lays the charm on thick with Naomi.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Arg goes boating on his second date with Yasemin, Toff travels to Wales for a blind date with a stripper, while agents Eden and Nadia push Calum outside of his comfort zone on a date with Louise

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Charlotte is sent on a blind date with Shauny from the singles mixer. Bobby goes on date number two with Paul, but will he manage to bag a kiss? Toff is desperate for her next date to go well.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Charlotte is still on the hunt for her perfect fella. Will James from Leeds hit the spot? Bobby is off to pastures new on a date with Jack from Hampshire and the pair try oysters for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Two new famous daters - X Factor star Frankie Cocozza and TV presenter Sarah-Jane Crawford - sign on to the agency's books and attend their first mixer event. Will Charlotte heed the agents' advice?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The famous boys on the agency's books are off to mixer number two. Frankie is nervous about the event. Will anyone catch his eye? And what happens when Arg and Calum fancy the same girl?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The agents plan to test Calum's naughty side by sending him to lunch with a PVC-wearing cougar. Bobby and Jack have a hot date at a Spanish restaurant. Toff has second thoughts about her latest guy.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Nadia and Eden have a big surprise for Calum and Charlotte. Frankie's off to Leeds for a second date. Is the Brighton rocker getting closer to settling down? Toff catches up with her Nan for a talk.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The agents send Arg and Sarah-Jane on a double date and plan for Charlotte to have an etiquette lesson. Bobby's feelings for Jack are tested by a hot new man. Will his head be turned?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: At a speed dating event, Charlotte wants to see the goods on all her dates, Frankie has a shocker, and Bobby is put on the spot when a familiar face returns. Will anyone bag a date?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: It's speed dating time and the celebs meet a squad of hotties. Can Sarah-Jane find her flirting skills, will Arg's confidence take a knock, can Calum crack on and will Toff locate her perfect match?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The agents send Charlotte and Frankie on a double date to Blackpool. Bobby has another date with Jack. There's a new arrival as Hollywood's Courtney Stodden jets in from LA looking for love.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Frankie and Charlotte confess to getting it on with each other instead of their dates. Arg puts his kilt on and legs it up to Edinburgh for his third date with Yasemin. Courtney's in for a big shock.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The agents spice things up as they send the celebs to sensory dating, where they have to rely on much more than their chat to bag a date. And things get heated between Charlotte and Frankie.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: It's blindfolds on as the celebs get all touchy-feely at the agents' sensory dating event. Charlotte heads to Blackpool to work out her Frankie dilemma. Arg's date takes a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Toff faces her biggest challenge yet as she helps Arg improve his table manners in order to impress his date, while Courtney brings her own Hollywood charm to punting in Cambridge

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The agents' final party is just around the corner so the pressure is on to find the perfect partner. Toff and Courtney are in the last chance saloon. Frankie has big news for the agents and Charlotte.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: It's the day of the agents' party and the celebs are all under pressure to bring their perfect plus-one to the event. After being asked out by Frankie, Charlotte has a tough decision to make.

videos.title: Episode 1

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The celebs go on their first dates. Gemma Collins has a dodgy start. Made in Chelsea's Sam Thompson uses his Harry Potter impression to wow his date. And the agents fume with Muggy Mike Thalassitis.

videos.overview: Sam Thompson is left stunned on his next date. Back at the agency, there's big news for receptionist Tom and, having walked out on her last date, Gemma Collins is summoned for crisis talks.

videos.title: Episode 5

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Gemma goes on a first date with audio visual engineer Ben. Sam, Jonathan and Muggy Mike arrive in Edinburgh on a lads' dating away day. They date two girls each and then choose one to take to dinner.

videos.overview: Comedian London Hughes has some fun with a huge wrestler on a date in Wales. Competition heats up between Jade and Tallia as they battle it out for the same guy. Meanwhile, Ollie is sent on two dates.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Racing driver and model Seb Morris joins the dating agency, but Tallia is his ex and he has no idea she's already on the books. Sam gets a dressing down from the agents and Jonathan has a blind date.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Gemma heads out on her second date with Ben and things get off to a flying start. Muggy Mike meets contortionist Lauren on a trapeze. London goes to play crazy golf with personal trainer Elliot.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Emotions run high as exes Seb and Tallia visit the agency to confront Nadia and Eden. Ollie has a second date with Ruben, who shows him his questionable tattoo. Sam faces his biggest challenge yet.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Nadia confronts Gemma about Arg. Sam and Jade learn new tricks in a flirting workshop. Mike fails to turn on the charm during his double date with Sam. Seb dates a new girl, but is she interested?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Gemma heads off on a date with Daniel. Ollie gets some brutal advice from Binky, and there's a second date for London and Elliot. The agents bring in a relationship expert to help Tallia and Seb.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The agency throws its first masquerade mixer. Mike's hot tub snog catches up with him. Gemma has two men fighting over her. Jonathan dates Becca but faces an interrogation from her best friend, Carly.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Desperate for guidance, Gemma consults the stars, while Sam turns to his sister Louise for advice. Jade and London's double date has disastrous consequences, and Seb's date with Jess ends awkwardly.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The agents meet Mike for crisis talks. Ollie goes skiing on his date with Dr Jason. One of the celebs leaves the agency with an emotional goodbye. Gemma's date with Laurence in Paris turns dramatic.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Nadia and Eden are on the warpath, and Gemma is confronted by Laurence after her Paris no-show. Sam dates Emilia again to test his feelings, Mike turns to his mate for advice, and Jade has a spa date.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Gemma's head is a mess as she weighs up the two men chasing her. Ollie tries to decide whether Dr Jason is Mr Right. Has Muggy Mike met his match with Celine? And it's crunch time for Seb and Tallia.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Cape Verde is just around the corner, but Tallia is no closer to finding a date. Gemma's on a second date with Laurence. Seb bounces back big time with Sarah. Sam tries to decide who to take away.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: It's mini-break time as the celebs head off to Cape Verde. Sam has to tell Tammy and Emilia about each other. Laurence and Daniel vie for Gemma's affections. And the celebs attend a pool party.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: The celebs enjoy fun in the sun with their dates in Cape Verde. All except one, who decides they're better off alone. It's decision time for Sam and Gemma. Just who will they take to the final party?

videos.title: Episode 1

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Olivia Attwood, Chloe Sims and Sam Craske are sent out on dates on the first night, unaware that new agent Paul and Nadia are secretly watching their every move in another room. After her disastrous mixer, Sugababe Mutya Buena is set up with tattoo fan Ryan.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Two new celebrity arrivals rock up at the dating agency: Ibiza Weekender's Callum Izzard, who's got a reputation as a ladies' man, and Gogglebox star Amy Tapper, who has never been on a date

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: On a dating mini-break, Alik, Olivia, Amy and Callum visit a beautiful country mansion, hosted by Nadia. Meanwhile, Paul has taken Eyal, Mutya, Vas, Chloe and Sam to a mini-mixer in Liverpool.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Eyal and Mutya enjoy all the fun of the fair on their dates. Olivia causes carnage at a cider tasting in the country and crashes Alik's date. Chloe, Vas and Sam experience an awkward triple date.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Chloe is delighted to learn about date George's St Tropez lifestyle. Olivia is told off for her wild ways. Vas and Mutya go on a double date with flight attendant Nick and landscape gardener Danny.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Eyal and Sam get bromantic when they go double dating, while Alik becomes mushy and gushy on his night out. The agents send Amy on a medieval-themed date, and Olivia goes on her second date with Zak.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Mutya follows the agents' flirty instructions on a blind date with David. Chloe and Olivia have a double date with Ryan and Chris, but it goes downhill. Callum gets ballsy on a first date with Nicole.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Paul and Nadia have a big surprise for Vas when he goes on a date with a difference: axe throwing! Eyal gets emotional after some tough love from the agents. Sam is instructed to have more fun.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: There's a mixer with a twist as the celebs' previous dates are invited back. Amy has an awkward encounter with former date Caleb, Callum gets into hot water, and Chloe decides to skip the party.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Eyal gets a flirting masterclass and puts his new knowledge into practice. Callum's Nan gives him some home truths. Things take a turn for the worse for Olivia on date three with real tennis pro Zak.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Olivia tries a different approach on her date with Tommy. Paul heads to Essex in an attempt to work out what's going wrong for Chloe. Sam takes things to the next level under the blanket on his date.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Vas attends a confidence masterclass before his second date with Nick. Alik goes on a date with Italian art lover Isadora. Chloe enjoys a dinner time dating feast of three different men.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Chloe has another date with Essex lad Craig, but will his banter win her over? Mutya gets a final date with gym fan Jonathan. Eyal is told to slow things down on his second date with a tattoo artist.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Vas goes on a sensory speed date to find his perfect partner. Sam has big news for agent Paul. Things look up for Olivia on her second date with Tommy. Chloe gets some dating advice from her sister.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Sam admits he has a soft spot for fellow celeb Olivia. Alik has fallen for two women and dates both on the same day. Amy goes on a third date with Ace but is surprised when he brings his father along.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The mini-break has arrived as the celebs are off to Crete, but Callum's decision to invite two girls along comes back to bite him on the behind in a big way. Sam can't stop thinking about Olivia.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: All the celebs are enjoying some sexy fun in the sun on Crete with their dates. Olivia and Sam have a heart-to-heart talk about their feelings. Just who will they take to the final party?
